usage.useWhen: A single pictogram next to a heading, in a feature column or as a small linked symbol, for example a phone icon that links to the number.
usage.avoidWhen: Lists of benefits or contact details; use the icon list. Logos and photos; use the image block.
usage.a11y: Without a label the icon is decorative and hidden from screen readers. Set a label when the icon carries meaning; a link renders only with a label, which becomes its name.
